conversation.message: Recommendation systems analyze past user behavior and preferences, as well as similarities between items or users, to suggest new content or products. They often use algorithms like collaborative filtering or content-based filtering to make these predictions.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Collaborative filtering is a technique where the system predicts what a user might like based on the preferences of similar users. It essentially finds people with similar tastes and recommends items they enjoyed.
